Personal data notice

Data controller
The teacher who enters student information into the app, and the school they work for, are the data controller. The app developer does not access or process this data.

Data processed
Student first name, last name, student number and class; exam answers, scores and performance statistics.

Purpose and legal basis
Grading exams, monitoring student progress and preparing result reports, as part of providing education.

Storage and transfer
The app works offline. Data is stored only on the phone (or computer) the teacher uses; the app does not transfer it to any server or third party, in the country or abroad. If the teacher chooses, they can save a backup to their own Google Drive account; in that case the transfer is made by the teacher's own choice under Google's terms. The teacher is responsible for reports and backups they choose to share.

Collection method
Manual entry, import from an Excel list and reading answer sheets with the camera.

Retention period
Until the teacher deletes the data or uninstalls the app.

Rights
Students and their parents exercise their data protection rights by contacting the teacher or school, who is the data controller.

Netice, öğretmenlerin optik cevap kâğıtl:
Netice is designed for teachers to scan optical answer sheets and analyse the results.

Works offline, data stays on your device
Netice works without an internet connection. Everything you enter and scan is stored only on the phone (or computer) where you use the app, in the app's own folder. The app does not require an account and sends no data to the developer or third parties.

Optional Google account
In Settings > Account you can sign in with your Google account and save your backup to your own Google Drive. This feature connects to the internet only when you turn it on; the backup is kept in a hidden app folder on your Drive that only Netice can see, and it never reaches the developer. If you don't use it, the app stays completely offline.

Product suggestions
At the bottom of the home page there is a product suggestion card from the developer's own store (SepetMix), which you can close. No ad network is used, no advertising ID is read and you are not tracked. When there is an internet connection, only the public product list is downloaded, at most once a day; this request contains no information about you or your students. When you tap a product, the store page opens in your browser and that site's own rules apply.

Netice Pro subscription
Scanning and basic results are free. Term reports, report cards, sending to parents, Google Drive backup, advanced charts and the official letterhead come with a Netice Pro subscription; you can try it free for 14 days after installing, with no card required. Payment is taken by Google Play; your card and payment details never reach the developer. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period and can be cancelled at any time in Google Play > Subscriptions.

Information kept
Student first name, last name, student number and class; exam name, date, answer key and outcomes; marks, scores and statistics from scanned sheets; school and teacher details. This information is stored only on this device, in the app's own folder; it is never uploaded to a server.

Camera and photos
The camera is used only with your permission, to read answer sheets. Images are processed on the device. A flattened image of each scanned sheet is kept only on this device so you can view the marked sheet later; it is never sent anywhere and is deleted when you delete the exam or your data.

Sharing and backup
You decide whether to share reports, lists and backup files. A file you share is subject to the rules of the app you choose (email, cloud, printer). Backup files contain student information; keep them somewhere safe.

Data not collected
Location, contacts, device ID, usage statistics, crash reports and advertising ID are not collected.

Deletion
You can delete students, exams and sheets one by one, or all at once with Settings > "Delete all data"; you can choose to delete the automatic backups too. If you use Google Drive backup, you can delete it in Settings > Account. When the app is uninstalled, all data is deleted from the device.
